racial-integrity-1924.file: The Virginia Racial Integrity Act of 1924.jpg
racial-integrity-1924.alt: Front page of the Virginia Health Bulletin, March 1924, headed 'The New Virginia Law To Preserve Racial Integrity'.
racial-integrity-1924.caption: The Virginia Health Bulletin of March 1924, explaining the new law 'to preserve racial integrity'.

loving-1967.file: Mildred and Richard Loving 1967 by UPI.jpg
loving-1967.alt: Black-and-white photograph of Mildred and Richard Loving close together in front of a shelf of law books.
loving-1967.caption: Mildred and Richard Loving in 1967, the year the US Supreme Court ruled in their favour.

paneurope-1924.alt: World map with Europe, most of Africa, and parts of Asia and the Americas coloured blue.
paneurope-1924.caption: Pan-Europe 'according to Coudenhove-Kalergi, 1924', as redrawn by a Wikimedia Commons contributor; it is not the movement's own map. Africa appears inside it.

iea-map-1936.alt: Colour map headed 'Africa Orientale Italiana', with Ethiopia labelled 'Impero di Etiopia' and the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden on the upper right.
iea-map-1936.caption: Italy's official map of Africa Orientale Italiana, Istituto Geografico Militare, Florence, 1936.

fiat-tagliero-asmara.alt: The Fiat Tagliero service station in Asmara, a white building with a tower and long cantilevered concrete wings.
fiat-tagliero-asmara.caption: The Fiat Tagliero service station in Asmara, a building from the Italian colonial period.

berlin-cake-1885.alt: Pen drawing of Otto von Bismarck standing with a raised knife over a cake labelled 'AFRIQUE', with six delegates seated around a table watching him.
berlin-cake-1885.caption: A French cartoon of the Berlin Conference: Bismarck, who called it, cuts a cake labelled 'Afrique' while the delegates watch. L'Illustration, 3 January 1885, uncredited.

rhodes-colossus-1892.alt: Engraving from Punch of Cecil Rhodes as a giant with one foot at the Cape and the other in north Africa, holding a telegraph wire, captioned 'The Rhodes Colossus, striding from Cape Town to Cairo'.
rhodes-colossus-1892.caption: 'The Rhodes Colossus: striding from Cape Town to Cairo', by Edward Linley Sambourne, Punch, 10 December 1892. A satirist's picture of ambition, not a record of borders.

musa-catalan-atlas.file: Catalan Atlas BNF Sheet 6 Mansa Musa (cropped).jpg
musa-catalan-atlas.alt: Medieval painted map detail of a crowned, seated king holding a gold nugget in one hand and a sceptre in the other.
musa-catalan-atlas.caption: The king of Mali holding a gold nugget, from the Catalan Atlas of 1375 (attributed to Abraham Cresques).

adwa-painting.alt: Brightly coloured Ethiopian painting of the Battle of Adwa, with rows of Ethiopian soldiers on the left and Italian troops and cannon on the right, and a saint on horseback in a rainbow above.
adwa-painting.caption: An Ethiopian painting of the Battle of Adwa; the artist is unknown.

husuni-kubwa.file: Husuni Kubwa, ruins of early 14th cent. sultan's palace on Kilwa Kisiwani (3) (28454143003).jpg
husuni-kubwa.alt: Ruins of coral-stone walls and terraces of the Husuni Kubwa palace on Kilwa Kisiwani, with bush and trees growing among them.
husuni-kubwa.caption: The ruins of Husuni Kubwa, the palace complex on Kilwa Kisiwani.

axum-obelisk-engraving.file: Henry Salt - View of the Obelisk and Church at Axum 1248719.jpg
axum-obelisk-engraving.alt: Early nineteenth-century engraving of a tall stone obelisk beside a church at Axum, with trees, hills and three small figures in the foreground.
axum-obelisk-engraving.caption: 'View of the Obelisk and Church at Axum', an engraving after Henry Salt.

ezana-stone.alt: A tall slab of grey stone standing inside a small stone building, its surface covered in lines of inscribed letters.
ezana-stone.caption: The Ezana Stone at Aksum, an inscribed stone of King Ezana.

meroe-pyramids.alt: Two steep-sided stone pyramids rising from desert sand dunes under a pale sky.
meroe-pyramids.caption: The pyramids at Meroë, Sudan.

injera-mitad.file: Injera stove .. and fresh Injera being cooked.JPG
injera-mitad.alt: A large round clay griddle over a small wood fire, with a thin layer of pale injera batter cooking on it.
injera-mitad.caption: Injera batter cooking on a mitad, the large round griddle, over a wood fire.

jollof-rice.alt: A heap of orange-red cooked rice, the colour of jollof, in a white container.
jollof-rice.caption: Jollof rice.

cassava-roots.alt: A hand holding up several freshly harvested cassava roots, with soil still on them, against a cloudy sky and green plants.
cassava-roots.caption: Harvested cassava roots.

timbuktu-astronomy.alt: Two open pages of an old Arabic manuscript with circular diagrams and lines of handwritten text.
timbuktu-astronomy.caption: Pages of Timbuktu manuscripts with circular astronomical diagrams.

tissot-mercator.alt: A Mercator world map with equal red circles at regular intervals, growing larger toward the poles.
tissot-mercator.caption: A Mercator map with identical circles placed at regular intervals: on the map they grow larger toward the poles, though all are the same size on the ground.

ashanti-funeral-dance.alt: Gruppo di suonatori e danzatori tradizionali ashanti durante una celebrazione funebre in Ghana.
ashanti-funeral-dance.caption: Suonatori e danzatori durante un rito funebre ashanti in Ghana.

fantasy-coffin-cocoa.alt: Bara figurativa ghanese (abebuu adekai) a forma di frutto del cacao arancione, opera del maestro Paa Joe.
fantasy-coffin-cocoa.caption: Bara figurativa (abebuu adekai) a forma di frutto del cacao, creata dal maestro Paa Joe in Ghana.
